subject.title: feat: add Codex session MCP profile

question: Should the native Codex sidebar collection metadata ship in this core profile despite being absent from inspected open-source Codex current main?
rationale: Mechanical review can validate the bounded Gateway bridge, but only maintainers can accept experimental or private host coupling or choose a plugin-owned presentation boundary.

options.title: Gate native collection
options.body: Keep the global MCP App fallback and require explicit compatible-host proof before enabling or documenting the native sidebar contribution.

options.title: Accept experimental coupling
options.body: Ship the metadata with an explicit decision to own compatibility with the experimental or private Codex host contract.

options.title: Move metadata to plugin
options.body: Keep bounded session operations in core while the Codex plugin owns host-specific presentation and entrypoint metadata.

recommendation.title: Gate native collection
recommendation.body: Keep the global MCP App fallback and require explicit compatible-host proof before enabling or documenting the native sidebar contribution.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history ties this person most directly to the existing channel MCP bridge, CLI surface, and Codex integration direction.
